g.text: Two Machines, Same Millisecond, No Collision
Identical timestamp bits. Different machine-ID bits. The 64-bit IDs can never collide -- with zero communication between the machines.
No lookup, no lock, no network call between A and B. Each machine only ever needs its own clock and its own
leased machine_id -- the two fields never have to agree on anything to guarantee the final 64-bit IDs differ.
